title: FlipGuard: Defending Preference Alignment against Update Regression with Constrained Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge prompted with Chinese CVALUES dataset guidelines, which explicitly penalize stereotypes, prejudice, and discrimination against disabled individuals (e.g., relying on stereotypical assumptions about blind people).
Evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge prompted with CVALUES principles to penalize the stigmatization, stereotyping, and incorrect assumptions regarding individuals with depression.

Evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge instructed by CVALUES guidelines to ensure equal treatment, empathy, and the elimination of prejudice and discrimination against disadvantaged or vulnerable populations.
